# The licence of a component the inventory states no SPDX identifier for.
#
# Fields are separated by " :: ": the component as name@version exactly as the
# inventory names it, the SPDX identifier, and where the licence was read.
#
# A NuGet package may carry its licence as a file inside the archive or as a link
# in its manifest, and neither reaches the identifier field CycloneDX writes. So
# an entry here is a reading somebody made of the package itself, recorded so that
# a later reader can make the same one rather than trust this line.
#
# It is keyed on the exact version. A licence can change between two releases of
# one package, and a key without a version would carry one reading forward over
# every release after it. The cost is that a dependency bump takes the reading
# with it: the old entry is refused as dangling until it is removed or moved on.
#
# This is not an acceptance register. An identifier this repository may not ship
# under is refused here as well, because the repair for an incompatible licence is
# removing the component rather than recording that it is present.

BitFaster.Caching@2.5.4 :: MIT :: LICENSE inside the package, which opens "MIT License"
BitFaster.Caching@2.6.0 :: MIT :: LICENSE inside the package, which opens "MIT License"
Diacritics@4.0.17 :: MIT :: LICENSE inside the package, which opens "MIT License"
Diacritics@4.1.8 :: MIT :: LICENSE inside the package, which opens "MIT License"
ICU4N@60.1.0-alpha.356 :: Apache-2.0 :: LICENSE.txt inside the package, which is the Apache License, Version 2.0
ICU4N.Transliterator@60.1.0-alpha.356 :: Apache-2.0 :: LICENSE.txt inside the package, which is the Apache License, Version 2.0
J2N@2.0.0 :: Apache-2.0 :: LICENSE.txt inside the package, which is the Apache License, Version 2.0
SerilogAnalyzer@0.15.0 :: Apache-2.0 :: the licenseUrl its manifest carries, which serves the Apache License, Version 2.0
SmartAnalyzers.MultithreadingAnalyzer@1.1.31 :: MIT :: the licenseUrl its manifest carries, which serves the MIT License
